extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants and practitioners filing Track One (Prioritized Examination) requests via USPTO Patent Center (registered and guest filers)
extracted.subtask_description: Step-by-step procedural guidance for submitting a Track One Prioritized Examination request (including PE‑RCE) via the USPTO Patent Center, covering required forms, document formats, fees, upload/indexing, and payment rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access to Patent Center
rubrics_metrics.description: Filer must be able to access Patent Center.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritized Examination requests via Patent Center are accepted only for nonprovisional utility applications. If you cannot access Patent Center you cannot file Track One via Patent Center.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of Office Form PTO/AIA/424 (recommended)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants are strongly advised to use the Office’s certification and request form to request prioritized examination (PTO/AIA/424), but the form is not required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Failure to use form PTO/AIA/424 could result in the Office not recognizing the request or delays in processing the request. If applicant uses an applicant-created form, it should be equivalent to the Office’s form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required fees to be paid (general list)
rubrics_metrics.description: Consult the current fee schedule for correct fee amounts. The fees required to be paid on a utility patent application upon filing a request for prioritized examination are: Basic filing fee (37 CFR 1.16(a)), Search fee (37 CFR 1.16(k)), Examination fee (37 CFR 1.16(o)), Publication fee (37 CFR 1.18(d)), Prioritized examination processing fee (37 CFR 1.17(i)(1)), and Prioritized examination fee (37 CFR 1.17(c)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See USPTO fee schedule for current amounts. The guide lists examples and codes (e.g., Request for Prioritized Examination $4,200.00 for regular undiscounted).

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional applicable fees (size/claims/RCE)
rubrics_metrics.description: If applicable, pay application size fee (specification/drawings exceed 100 sheets, 37 CFR 1.16(s)), excess independent claim fee (independent claims > 3, 37 CFR 1.16(h)), excess claim fee (claims > 20, 37 CFR 1.16(i)), and, if requesting prioritized examination for an RCE, the RCE fee (37 CFR 1.17(e)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include these fees at filing if they apply; warnings will be shown if required fees are unchecked.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility via Patent Center
rubrics_metrics.description: Prioritized Examination requests via Patent Center are accepted only for nonprovisional utility applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requests for prioritized examination for plant applications must be filed by paper.

rubrics_metrics.name: Completeness requirement at time of submission
rubrics_metrics.description: If a Prioritized Examination request has been submitted but a necessary component has been omitted, the omitted component must be submitted as a follow-on document on the same day as the original submission. Prioritized Examination requests that are not complete on the day they are submitted will be dismissed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Timely same-day correction is required to avoid dismissal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Session timeout / save behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Patent Center sessions time-out after 30 minutes of inactivity. A Prioritized Examination request that has not been submitted or saved after 30 minutes of inactivity will be lost.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registered filers can save progress (saved submissions available for 14 calendar days); guest filers cannot save and are strongly advised to pay fees online as part of the submission or ensure payment same day.

rubrics_metrics.name: DOCX requirement to avoid Non‑DOCX surcharge
rubrics_metrics.description: The specification, claims, and abstract for a new utility nonprovisional patent application must be filed in DOCX format in order to avoid a Non‑DOCX surcharge (up to $400).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants may also optionally submit an Auxiliary PDF of their application, but must upload it in the appropriate space to avoid the Non‑DOCX surcharge.

rubrics_metrics.name: Upload required Certification and Request form
rubrics_metrics.description: A Track One application must include the PTO/AIA/424 Form (Certification and Request for Prioritized examination).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: On the Upload Documents screen upload PTO/AIA/424 or equivalent, index the document correctly; failure to use the form or index properly could result in the Office not recognizing the request or delays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document indexing and Category/Description selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Once the PTO/AIA/424 is attached, you will need to index the document correctly. For the Category drop-down select 'Track One – Prioritized Examination' and for Document Description select 'Track One Request'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Patent Center may auto-assign a document description; if not, filers must index manually.

rubrics_metrics.name: File-upload validation: warnings vs errors
rubrics_metrics.description: If any uploaded documents have warnings you may continue with the warnings or remove and reupload; if any documents have errors, you must remove the documents, make changes and reupload. Patent Center will not allow you to submit documents with errors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review preview and validation messages; resolve errors before submitting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Calculate Fees: entity status and application data
rubrics_metrics.description: On the 'Calculate fees' screen select entity status (regular/small/micro) and complete information (# pages, # claims, # independent claims, petitions, statutory disclaimers, etc.) to accurately calculate fees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If required fees are not selected, a warning is displayed. The correct processing fee code for Track One is 'Processing fee, except in provisional applications' (fee code 1830/2830/3830); example Regular Undiscounted amount $140.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timing requirement for fee payment (same-day cutoff)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fee payment is considered timely if paid before midnight Eastern Time on the day the request is submitted. If paying later in a follow-on submission, the payment must be processed before 11:59:59 pm ET on the same day under Track One requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guest users are strongly advised to pay fees online during submission because they cannot access a submitted application to pay later; failure to timely pay required fees may cause delays or dismissal and may incur surcharges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required processing/publication fees at filing (Track One)
rubrics_metrics.description: For Track One – Prioritized Examination the processing and publication fees are required at filing (the guide also advises ensuring the Track One Prioritized Examination fee and the Track One Processing fee under 37 CFR 1.17(i)(1) are included; include publication fee if not previously paid and any excess claim or application size fees).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note in the guide there's also a statement 'NOTE: the publication fee is not applicable anymore. Please see USPTO fee schedule.' Always consult current fee schedule.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review & Submit: review all entered data and uploaded documents
rubrics_metrics.description: On the Review & Submit screen, filers must review all entered data and preview each uploaded document to ensure correctness before submitting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If there are any errors in the displayed data, go back and edit the information before submitting to the USPTO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acknowledgement Receipt and contents
rubrics_metrics.description: After clicking 'Submit', Patent Center displays an Acknowledgement Receipt showing application details, uploaded document details (including page numbers and any warnings), confirmation and Patent Center IDs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registered filers can view acknowledgement history under Workbench; save/print/email receipt as needed; receipt establishes filing/receipt evidence per MPEP.

rubrics_metrics.name: PE availability window (when you may request Prioritized Examination)
rubrics_metrics.description: Prioritized Examination is only available to be requested on the date of filing the application, or after a proper RCE has been filed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guide repeats this warning and displays pop-ups reminding filers; ensure timing condition met before requesting Track One.

rubrics_metrics.name: PE‑RCE: RCE must be proper (prosecution closed)
rubrics_metrics.description: A request for prioritized examination for an RCE will not be granted unless the RCE is proper. A proper RCE can only be filed if prosecution is closed (e.g., the last Office action is a final action, a notice of allowance, or an action that otherwise closes prosecution in the application). See 37 CFR 1.114(b).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When filing Track One concurrently with an RCE, attach PTO/AIA/424 and the RCE; if RCE was previously filed, attach only PTO/AIA/424.

rubrics_metrics.name: Different workflow for original U.S. (35 U.S.C. 111) vs national stage (35 U.S.C. 371)
rubrics_metrics.description: The procedure differs depending on whether the application was filed as an original U.S. application under 35 U.S.C. 111 (part A) or as a national stage entry under 35 U.S.C. 371 (part B).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For national stage filings, use the Calculate Fees screen to select national stage search option and fees, and select RCE fee under basic filing fees if not previously paid.

rubrics_metrics.name: National stage specific fee options
rubrics_metrics.description: For U.S. national stage under 35 U.S.C. 371, select the appropriate National Stage Search option (e.g., 'National Stage Search Fee - U.S. was the ISA', 'search report prepared and provided to USPTO', 'all other situations').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also select basic national stage fees (e.g., basic national stage fee, national stage examination fee) and other applicable fees listed on the Calculate Fees page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Warning re: use of Deposit Account / pre‑authorization
rubrics_metrics.description: When using the USPTO Deposit Account as a method of payment, the fee associated with 37 CFR 1.18 is not available as an option for a pre-authorized payment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: It is strongly recommended to include an authorization to file any additional necessary fees under 37 CFR 1.16, 1.17, and 1.18 to ensure the Track One request is not dismissed for insufficient fees upon filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission availability timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Submissions are available in Patent Center approximately 15 minutes after they are submitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registered filers can review the filed application in Patent Center to ensure it is complete and loaded correctly into USPTO internal systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment options and receipts
rubrics_metrics.description: When paying fees you may use Charge USPTO Deposit Account, Charge Credit Card, or Electronic Funds Transfer; after payment you receive a Payment Receipt showing amount paid and application details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You can print/save the Payment Receipt and view submission/payment receipts under Workbench in Patent Center.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact support for filing assistance
rubrics_metrics.description: If you have any questions or concerns regarding filing in Patent Center, contact the Patent EBC by email ebc@uspto.gov or telephone 866-217-9197 (hours Monday - Friday, 6:00 a.m. to 12 Midnight Eastern Time).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use EBC for troubleshooting submission, fee, or document issues.
